notes.title: Big Update to version 2.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=DbXF3P-7wcU;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello dear users, I have to announce the first major update of the game Girls Vs Zombies, with the introduction of two [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42969603/c9002df63457d0c7314fa1d239be242290091b76.jpg[/img]new [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42969603/9aa44c6ffd75979608fbdd629af9b57f4dfa5c77.jpg[/img]characters, new game mechanics, very important gameplay updates, now the escape through the plane has been updated to be less confusing and tedious, you can be sure that most of the users' requests have been taken into consideration in this version, it took a lot of time because it was a lot of work for a single person but it's finally here and with a route of future updates, be sure that Girls Vs Zombies has a lot of future ahead, I appreciate your comments and opinions are always taken into consideration.

notes.title: 2023 First Update
notes.content: Hi players i already made the new update for the game, now adding new enemies and achievements, unlock achievements only in single player mode, also made some chanegs to fire and bombs graphics thanks and regards.
